correctness.rationale: For n>=4 and q in (0,1), collapse deterministic edges into four positive integer arc masses l_i. Pair connection between adjacent arcs is c1=q+q^3-q^4; opposite c2=2q^2-q^4. Exact uniform-seed outbreak expectation is l^T C l/n. Orthogonal decomposition into total, two opposite contrasts and alternating contrast gives n*lambda0/4+[lambda1(u^2+v^2)/2+lambda2(a-b)^2/4]/n. Since lambda1,lambda2>0 and lambda1-lambda2=2q(1-q)^2>0, minimizers are uniquely the balanced four-arc patterns up to dihedral symmetry; for n mod4=2 the two larger arcs must be opposite, with strict adjacent penalty 2q(1-q)^2/n. Fresh exact rational enumeration of all 4-part compositions n=4..17 at three q values confirms the algebraic classification.
residual_risks: Finite checks cannot certify all q; proof uses exact positive eigenvalues and integer parities.
Endpoints q=0,1 excluded because strictness disappears.
